## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 24, 2026 - Oct 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _tmac66_, Oct 2, 2026, 1/5: "Filled with bugs and glitches this app needs a lot of work. I get the feeling this thing was thrown together overnight. If you’re a beginner be very careful because this app does not guide you as it should. It doesn’t ask if you have any medical issues such as rotator cuff bad back or any following type of injuries that would potentially prevent you from doing certain exercises. I have found that it adds sets. I had one exercise were it had me doing it 10 times."
            2. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            3. _East County Mom_, Sep 23, 2026, 3/5: "App glitches more often than not. Workouts don’t always feel like they flow well together."
